schema.pattern: {path}: does not match the expected format ({pattern})
schema.minLength: {path}: must be at least {limit} characters long
schema.maxLength: {path}: must be at most {limit} characters long
error.path.type: the path must be a string
error.path.nul: the path contains a NUL character
error.path.absolute: the path must not be absolute
error.path.tilde: the path must not start with "~"
error.path.dotdot: the path must not contain ".." segments
error.path.outside: the path "{path}" leaves the allowed folder
error.key.too_long: the key is longer than {limit} characters
error.key.segment_too_long: a key segment ("{segment}...") is longer than {limit} characters
error.project.version_too_new: the project requires version {required} and this is {current}
error.project.name_taken: a project "{name}" is already registered at {root}
error.order.unknown: there is no order "{order}" with profile "{profile}" in project "{project}"
error.order.count_invalid: the number of attempts must be an integer from {min} to {max}
error.order.discard_chosen: attempt {attempt} is the chosen one and cannot be discarded
error.order.choose_discarded: attempt {attempt} is discarded and cannot be chosen
error.order.undo_discarded: attempt {attempt} is discarded and undo cannot choose it again; mark it `new` or `candidate` first
error.machine.bad_name: invalid machine profile name: "{name}" (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; for a file, use a path with / or ending in .json)
error.limit.references: the attempt has {count} references and the machine allows {max}
error.limit.steps: the attempt asks for {steps} steps and the machine allows {max}
error.limit.pixels: the attempt asks for {width}x{height} ({pixels} pixels) and the machine allows {max}
error.engine.bad_delay: GIMG_FAKE_DELAY is not a finite number >= 0: "{value}"
error.log.bad_project: invalid project name for the log: "{project}"
error.queue.not_cancellable: entry {id} has already finished ({state}) and cannot be cancelled
error.queue.bad_state: invalid final state "{state}"; use one of: {states}
error.worker.reference_missing: the reference "{path}" does not exist or is not a file
error.worker.image_move: could not store the attempt image: {reason}
error.engine.timeout: the engine ran past the time limit
delivery.reserved: the delivery template "{path}" lands on the manifest, the config or the delivery folder itself
delivery.manifest_corrupt: the manifest {path} is corrupt; fix or delete it
delivery.source_missing: the image of attempt {attempt} ({path}) is missing; nothing is delivered
cli.description: Local AI image generator (queue, attempts, chosen candidate and delivery).
cli.help.lang: language of the messages (default: the system's)
cli.cmd.project_add: register the project in a folder
cli.cmd.order_submit: create or update an order and queue its attempts
cli.cmd.order_list: list the orders of a project
cli.cmd.order_show: show an order with its attempts
cli.cmd.attempt_new: queue new attempts (random seed unless --seed is given)
cli.cmd.attempt_mark: mark an attempt as new, candidate or discarded
cli.cmd.attempt_note: set the note of an attempt
cli.cmd.choose: choose an attempt and deliver it to the project
cli.arg.file: order JSON file, or - for standard input
cli.arg.chosen: only orders with a chosen attempt
cli.arg.unchosen: only orders without a chosen attempt
